scope: ARR May 2026 submission, EMNLP main conference target
framing: Deferral-as-operationalization; gap mechanism is one realization.

matrix.rationale: Interpretation A: drop HaluEval, add PubMedQA as medical showcase and MedQA as medical diagnostic; skip Path 3 held-out to manage budget.

chaosnli_aurc_improvement_over_pred_only.claim: Gap mechanism improves AURC over single-probe baseline on ChaosNLI by at least 0.015 averaged across 3 models.
chaosnli_aurc_improvement_over_pred_only.rationale: ChaosNLI has 100-annotator-per-item entropy supervision; f_amb has the richest per-item structure available.

pavlick_nli_aurc_improvement.claim: Gap mechanism improves AURC over single-probe baseline on Pavlick-NLI by at least 0.010 averaged across 3 models.
pavlick_nli_aurc_improvement.rationale: Pavlick-NLI has approximately 10-annotator-per-item disagreement; smaller annotator count than ChaosNLI but still showcase-regime.

ambigqa_aurc_improvement.claim: Gap mechanism improves AURC over single-probe baseline on AmbigQA-k>=2 by at least 0.010 averaged across 3 models.
ambigqa_aurc_improvement.rationale: AmbigQA has per-question answer-set size as y_expert; metadata-derived but per-item, distinct from per-category aggregates.

pubmedqa_aurc_improvement.claim: Gap mechanism improves AURC over single-probe baseline on PubMedQA by at least 0.010 averaged across 3 models.
pubmedqa_aurc_improvement.rationale: PubMedQA's maybe label directly encodes per-item expert uncertainty; medical-domain showcase test.

truthfulqa_no_improvement.claim: Gap mechanism does NOT improve AURC over single-probe baseline on TruthfulQA; AURC(gap) - AURC(p_pred) >= 0.
truthfulqa_no_improvement.rationale: TruthfulQA y_expert is per-category aggregate; current aggregate result for LLaMA shows AURC(gap)=0.445 vs AURC(p_pred)=0.323. Earlier references to 0.287/0.178 are stale intermediate-analysis values.

truthfulqa_credal_width_bimodal.claim: Bootstrap K=20 credal width on f_pred has median > 0.5 and credal width on f_defer has median < 0.10 on TruthfulQA.
truthfulqa_credal_width_bimodal.rationale: Mechanism-visible signature of SCOD-collapse regime; existing K=20 result already confirms median 0.97 vs 0.02.

medqa_no_improvement.claim: Gap mechanism does NOT improve AURC over single-probe baseline on MedQA; AURC(gap) - AURC(p_pred) >= 0.
medqa_no_improvement.rationale: MedQA y_expert is metadata-derived from question length; expected to fall in diagnostic regime per the source-by-granularity argument.

medqa_credal_width_diagnostic_signature.claim: Bootstrap K=20 credal width on f_defer has median < 0.10 on MedQA.
medqa_credal_width_diagnostic_signature.rationale: Pre-deployment diagnostic should correctly identify MedQA as a regime where the gap mechanism will not help.

credal_width_correlation_showcase.claim: On showcase datasets, per-item credal width on f_defer correlates negatively with model correctness with point-biserial rho <= -0.10 and p < 0.05 on at least 2 of 4 showcase datasets.
credal_width_correlation_showcase.rationale: If f_defer is informative, bootstrap probes should disagree more on items where the model is wrong.

credal_width_correlation_diagnostic.claim: On diagnostic datasets, per-item credal width on f_defer does NOT correlate with model correctness with p > 0.05 on at least 1 of 2 diagnostic datasets.
credal_width_correlation_diagnostic.rationale: Null result confirms the diagnostic regime.

showcase_vs_diagnostic_median_separation.claim: Median bootstrap credal width on f_defer is at least 5x larger on showcase datasets, mean across 4, than on diagnostic datasets, mean across 2.
showcase_vs_diagnostic_median_separation.rationale: The diagnostic regime split should be visible in the credal-width signature without test-time labels.

methodology_commitments.split_stratification: stratified by gold answer correctness within each dataset
methodology_commitments.no_HARKing_commitment: All hyperparameter choices and method variants are locked at the time of this pre-registration. Any post-hoc additions, including free-generation evaluation or semantic entropy baseline, are reported as sensitivity analyses in appendices and do not affect the primary headline numbers.

results_to_report_regardless_of_outcome: AURC for {gap, robust gap, p_pred, p_defer, output_logprob, semantic_entropy_if_available} on all 6 datasets x 3 models
Bootstrap K=20 credal width statistics on all cells
Per-item credal width vs y_correct correlations on all cells
Coverage at fixed accuracy targets {0.85, 0.90, 0.95} on all cells
